hooks.command:
MEMORY=$(grep -A3 'Phase' /Users/talsolomon/Documents/dubleslash/brain/memory.md 2>/dev/null | head -20); QUESTIONS=$(grep -A30 'open' /Users/talsolomon/Documents/dubleslash/brain/memory.md 2>/dev/null | head -30); DECISIONS=$(grep -A8 '## \[DECISION' /Users/talsolomon/Documents/dubleslash/decisionlog.md 2>/dev/null | tail -30); MSG=$(printf '[DS context for //]

=== PHASE + STATE ===
%s

=== OPEN QUESTIONS ===
%s

=== RECENT DECISIONS ===
%s

Context ready. Orient as a MOVE in 1-3 sentences. End with one DS skill suggestion.' "$MEMORY" "$QUESTIONS" "$DECISIONS"); jq -cn --arg msg "$MSG" '{"systemMessage": $msg}' 2>/dev/null || echo '{"systemMessage":"[DS] context ready — // mode ON"}'
jq -cn '{"systemMessage": "[DS] Write: kanban.md, node-map.md, decisionlog.md, memory/ — no asking, no permission needed."}' 2>/dev/null

echo '{"hookSpecificOutput": {"hookEventName": "PreCompact", "additionalContext": "[DS — pre-compact save] Context is about to be compressed. This is your last window. Write any unwritten decisions to decisionlog.md (ADR format) and any project state changes to memory.md NOW. Decisions first, memory second, artifacts third. Do not skip this."}}'

BRAIN=/Users/talsolomon/Documents/dubleslash/brain/memory.md; FALLBACK=/Users/talsolomon/Documents/dubleslash/memory.md; MEM_FILE=$([ -f "$BRAIN" ] && echo "$BRAIN" || echo "$FALLBACK"); WHAT=$(awk '/## What we.re building/{found=1} found{print} /^## [A-Z]/{if(found && !/## What/)exit}' "$MEM_FILE" 2>/dev/null | head -20); STATE=$(awk '/## Current state/{found=1} found{print} /^## [A-Z]/{if(found && !/## Current state/)exit}' "$MEM_FILE" 2>/dev/null | head -20); QUESTIONS=$(awk '/## What.s open/{found=1} found{print}' "$MEM_FILE" 2>/dev/null | head -30); LAST3=$(grep -B1 '**Status**: Closed' /Users/talsolomon/Documents/dubleslash/decisionlog.md 2>/dev/null | grep '## \[DECISION' | tail -3); MSG=$(printf '[DS SESSION START]

=== WHAT WE ARE BUILDING ===
%s

=== CURRENT STATE ===
%s

=== OPEN (what is blocking) ===
%s

=== LAST 3 DECISIONS ===
%s

Context loaded from brain/. Check session intent before reading more files. Orient as a MOVE, end with one DS skill.' "$WHAT" "$STATE" "$QUESTIONS" "$LAST3"); jq -cn --arg msg "$MSG" '{"systemMessage": $msg}' 2>/dev/null || echo '{"systemMessage":"[DS] session context loaded"}'
if ! lsof -ti:3333 >/dev/null 2>&1; then nohup node /Users/talsolomon/.claude/ds-viewer/server.js --project=/Users/talsolomon/Documents/dubleslash >/tmp/ds-viewer.log 2>&1 & disown; fi; exit 0

REPO=$(git rev-parse --show-toplevel 2>/dev/null || echo .); N=$(git -C "$REPO" config user.name 2>/dev/null); E=$(git -C "$REPO" config user.email 2>/dev/null); if [ "$N" != "Tal Solomon" ] || [ "$E" != "talsolomon21@gmail.com" ]; then git -C "$REPO" config user.name "Tal Solomon" >/dev/null 2>&1; git -C "$REPO" config user.email "talsolomon21@gmail.com" >/dev/null 2>&1; fi; exit 0

BRAIN=/Users/talsolomon/Documents/dubleslash/brain/memory.md; FALLBACK=/Users/talsolomon/Documents/dubleslash/memory.md; MEM_FILE=$([ -f "$BRAIN" ] && echo "$BRAIN" || echo "$FALLBACK"); PHASE=$(grep -m1 'Phase' "$MEM_FILE" 2>/dev/null | cut -d: -f2 | xargs 2>/dev/null); DECISIONS=$(grep '## \[DECISION' /Users/talsolomon/Documents/dubleslash/decisionlog.md 2>/dev/null | tail -3 | paste -sd '; ' 2>/dev/null); printf '{"hookSpecificOutput":{"hookEventName":"PostCompact","additionalContext":"[DS post-compact] Re-loaded context. Phase: %s. Last 3 decisions: %s — re-read brain/memory.md or decisionlog.md if more detail needed."}}\n' "$PHASE" "$DECISIONS"
hooks.statusMessage: DS reloading project context after compact...
